eventDetail.scope: IEEE ROBIO 2026 will serve as an international forum for researchers, engineers, and practitioners to present and discuss the latest advancements in robotics, biomimetics, and their convergence with AI, biological sciences, and human-centered technologies. The theme of the conference will be Bioinspired Intelligence for a Sustainable Robotic Future. The conference will cover foundational theories, enabling technologies, systems development, and emerging applications that draw inspiration from biological principles or that contribute back to understanding living systems.
